prompts.scene: Use case: ui-mockup / scientific-educational. Input image is a STYLE AND LAYOUT REFERENCE, not text instructions. Generate a polished 16:9 PREVIEW of a simple mirror optics experiment, matching the supplied reference's navy blue illustrated laboratory, frosted fine-grain texture, cool metal, precise proportions and shallow perspective. No text or UI panels baked into this preview. Upper 65%: dark blue restrained grid wall, subtle vignette, leave upper left clear for the existing page heading. Lower 35%: matte slate-blue laboratory tabletop, continuous horizontal optical bench rail running from x5% to95% at y66%. Rail has two parallel metal tracks and two end feet. At x14%, a compact laser emitter permanently mounted on a rigid silver vertical post and sliding-rail carriage, warm yellow aperture centered at y39%, pointing right. At x74%, one EMPTY universal mirror holder on a straight rigid post attached to a carriage that physically seats on the SAME rail; open gripping socket centered at the same y39% beam height. A very faint warm yellow beam travels horizontally from emitter to the empty holder height. Below rail, on the tabletop foreground, exactly THREE loose exchangeable mounted mirror inserts, neatly spaced x40%,50%,60%, all same physical diameter and proportions: a plane mirror insert, a concave mirror insert with clear inward curvature, a convex mirror insert with clear outward curvature. Each has a small dark rim and identical short mounting stem, NO separate heavy pedestal or tall stand. Show them at a slight oblique angle to reveal flat/inward/outward surfaces; distinguish by geometry, not arbitrary color. Coherent scale: mirror inserts around 60% of emitter housing height, much smaller than the rail posts, NOT towering props. Paper with faint optical graphite sketches, one pencil, one eraser, one closed notebook peek into bottom corners, minor accents with realistic size. Nothing blocks the laser or rail. No extra equipment, no sliders, buttons, values, labels, titles, arrows or gauges, no humans, no bright photographic reflections, no green beams. Maintain spacious central experimental area. This is a design preview only, NOT live software.
prompts.background: Use case: precise-object-edit. Asset: clean background layer derived from the reference optical lab preview. Preserve 16:9 exact camera, colors, fine frosted grain, navy grid wall and blue tabletop, bottom corner papers pencil eraser and notebook. Remove ALL experiment apparatus: laser source, posts, carriages, long horizontal rail, mirror holder and all three mirrors, also remove the yellow beam and ALL circles/vertical guides/measurement ticks. Reconstruct unobstructed navy fine grid wall in upper 65% and textured tabletop in lower35%. Keep horizon at65%. No letters, UI, numbers, axis, charts, circles, equipment, shadows from removed equipment, or ghost outlines. Subtle vignette and AO at horizon. This is standalone opaque background resource only; equipment and functional markings will be independent runtime layers.
prompts.equipment: Use case: scientific-educational / stylized-concept. Asset: TRANSPARENT layered optics equipment SPRITE SHEET matching reference style. Reference is for navy illustrated frosted-grain metal style and front/shallow-oblique perspective only. No background. Six non-overlapping components with ample transparent spacing, 2 columns by3rows, consistent scale and viewpoint, no labels or text. Top left: one LONG optical bench rail alone, horizontal double metal tracks with end feet, no carriages, no baked measurement marks; entire rail visible. Top right: compact warm-yellow-aperture laser emitter on rigid silver post and dark-blue sliding rail carriage, no rail under it, entire object visible. Middle left: EMPTY universal mirror clamp on rigid silver post and matching sliding carriage, no rail; gripping socket centered at SAME beam height relative carriage base as laser aperture, entire object visible. Middle right: flat plane mirror exchangeable insert alone, dark navy rim, short bottom mounting stem, no post or pedestal. Bottom left: CONCAVE mirror exchangeable insert alone, same rim diameter and short stem, strong visibly inward curved reflective surface. Bottom right: CONVEX mirror exchangeable insert alone, same rim diameter and short stem, visibly outward domed reflective surface. Mirrors side/oblique 25-degree view so their surface curvature is unambiguous. Three inserts physically fit into the SAME empty clamp socket, mirror insert diameter exactly equals clamp socket inner diameter. Rigid metal hardware, matching image lighting, restrained ice-blue broad highlights, polished silver reflective face. All components isolated on genuinely transparent alpha, no cast shadow outside each object except soft local contact shadow, no connecting beam, no annotations, no numbers, no decorative stationery. Sheet is an asset-preview layout, not a finished page; keep components independent for subsequent slicing/calibration.
